raw.cause: The deadlock fault in gps_handle(): while handling nav's MSG_POSITION (63860, received at 63870), gps calls MsgSend() back to nav for a MSG_HINT (63971) before replying. nav's only thread is REPLY-blocked on gps, so it can never MsgReceive the hint. gps stays SEND-blocked on nav (-63972) and nav stays REPLY-blocked on gps (-63861) forever. The gps->nav edge is both a contract violation and a send cycle, which is why the contract forbids it.
raw.qnx_call: MsgSend in gps (gps_handle, MSG_HINT to cockpit-nav) issued while holding nav's unreplied message
raw.fix_summary: Remove the call-back from gps to nav. gps is a leaf server and must answer MSG_POSITION from its own state, then MsgReply. If nav's hint is really needed, nav should push it inside its own request to gps, for example in msg->text or as a new field. That keeps the only edge nav -> gps, so the contract stays unchanged. Do not add gps -> nav to blueprint.yaml: it would legalise a cycle that deadlocks with single-threaded servers.
